title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-11-01
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: SBD > MC > C > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with noticeable tape hiss and a muddy low‑fi vibe, but the show shines thanks to monster Alligator, Uncle John’s Jam and Pigpen‑heavy moments.
ai_review.review: The recording is a classic ’69 sound‑board tape – you’ll hear the inevitable hiss and a bit of muddiness, plus an occasional drop in “Turn On Your Love Light”. Musically the band is on fire: Jerry solos over the Alligator jam, Pigpen dominates with five of his songs, and the Uncle John’s Jam and Good Lovin’ are highlighted as standout moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (many 4‑5 star comments about jams) outweighs the modest recording flaws; weighted average yields a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Prominent tape hiss, overall muddy sound for a 1969 source, occasional cut in “Turn On Your Love Light”; still listenable and captures the live atmosphere.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑heavy, laid‑back show driven by Pigpen and extended instrumental sections; transitions flow naturally with long improvisations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for a fiery solo over percussion during the Alligator jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) is mentioned as playing keyboards on this show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Ludwig drum kit and gongs are highlighted; drummers lock into the Alligator/Allman‑style jam.
